title: Canonical evaluation harness

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text: Started gate-independent harness work: KDATAP-60b9e7 (live CI precision defect) and KDATAP-524700 (`benchmark:materialize` broken). Canonical IR / adapters / evaluator remain blocked on the six design-epic rulings. Detection census KDATAP-fbd7fe is filed and blocked by materialize.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Review: KDATAP-60b9e7 / PR #9 — sent back

https://github.com/DataParade-io/scanner/pull/9

The per-layer bucket is the right cut and matches `score.ts`. Not done:

- `precision.spec.ts` still uses untagged findings, so it does not lock the new contract. The only regression lives in `corpus-precision.spec.ts` and only tests the “mention is not a component FP” direction.
- No unit case that a mention/`pii_signals` finding **is** still scored when that layer owns the scope.
- Scope is keyed on raw `annotation.layer`. `normalizeBenchmarkLayer` maps `pii_signals` → `mentions`; two names would double-count the same mention findings. Bucket by the normalized layer.

Issue was closed on the feature branch. Reopen until the unit contract is green.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Review passed — awaiting merge

- KDATAP-60b9e7 / PR #9: per-layer scope, `pii_signals`/`mentions` merged via `normalizeBenchmarkLayer`, unit contract in `precision.spec.ts`. Leave in progress until #9 is on `develop`.
- KDATAP-524700 / PR #11: compile-then-run matches `benchmark:run`; smoke test rejects `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. Leave in progress until #11 is on `develop`. Census KDATAP-fbd7fe stays blocked until then.
